name: Cabbage Omelet
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet on medium heat
Add oil to skillet and heat , do not burn
Add onions to hot oil and saute until well cooked but not yet browned , about 7 minutes
Add cabbage to skillet and saute , stirring constantly until cooked and takes on a translucent appearance
Onions should be starting to brown when cabbage is cooked
Pour beaten eggs over cabbage / onion mixture and mix into vegetables , cook until eggs are cooked
Serve as a side dish with a main meat course or as a main dish with steamed jasmine white rice
